adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Dominant lifelong hemolysis, iron overload, dehydrated red-cell indices and an explicit pathogenic PIEZO1 variant identify PIEZO1-associated hereditary xerocytosis; slowed mechanosensitive-channel inactivation is the mutation-specific mechanism.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: KCNN4/Gardos gain-of-function is a genuine alternative cause of dehydrated hereditary stomatocytosis, but it cannot be the best answer when the patient's pathogenic variant is explicitly PIEZO1.
